ajay: heads up — product wants a single dashboard that shows cost-per-1k-tokens plus a breakdown of cache & batching savings, split by routing policy / region / plan. need runtime + infra telemetry to compute unit econ. who owns what inputs?

tom: runtime can emit the following: runtime.tokens_generated, runtime.request_tokens, runtime.response_tokens, runtime.kv_cache_hits, runtime.kv_cache_requests, runtime.batch_size_p50/p95, runtime.seq_len_avg, runtime.model_variant, runtime.quantization_profile, runtime.gpu_ms_per_request, runtime.latency_ms.

maria: infra will provide pricing & infra usage: infra.gpu_minute_cost (by region/instance_type), infra.node_utilization_pct, infra.instance_tier, infra.network_egress_cost. we can also emit per-request allocation tags if runtime includes instance_id.

elena-devex: UX question — should console show cost as "cost per 1k tokens" computed at route-level and customer-level? product wants compare mode (baseline vs turned-on optimizations). also need quick toggle for sample window (1h/24h/7d). :eyes: 

sana: product wants the exact formula visible to users. proposal: 
```
cost_per_1k = (sum_over_requests(gpu_ms_per_request) / 60000) * gpu_cost_per_min * 1000 / sum_over_requests(total_tokens_per_request)
// then show breakdown: cache_savings = tokens_saved_from_cache / total_tokens, batch_savings = tokens_saved_from_batching_estimate, overhead = other_costs
```
we'll need clear definitions for "tokens_saved_from_cache" and how we attribute batching savings.

tom: ingestion concerns — emitting per-request gpu_ms is heavy. suggest runtime emit pre-aggregated 1-min buckets: {tags: model_variant, quant_profile, region, route, plan} with metrics: tokens, gpu_ms, kv_cache_hits, kv_cache_requests, batch_n_requests, batch_total_tokens. that keeps cardinality sane.

ajay: good. what tags are required for attribution? thinking: model_id, quant_profile, region, route_id, plan_tier, customer_id (optional for per-customer views). also need routing_policy tag (e.g., "cost_optimized", "latency_slo").

infra-bot: schema-proposal v2 uploaded to /telemetry/schemas/costing_metrics.json — fields + recommended rollup keys. (link: https://internal/schemas/telemetry/v2) :gear:

elena-devex: rollout UX — can we canary the dashboard by routing_policy? i.e., show only requests routed via "cost_optimized" or only from a single region/customer. console should support "compare windows" and annotate when sampling/aggregation was applied.

maria: quota overlap — note that quotas per-plan will affect observed tokens (throttled requests may lower token counts). infra will emit quota_throttled_count per route/plan to help correct the denominator. also propose a post-aggregation correction step: exclude throttled requests from cost calculations or surface them separately.

tom: analytics note — for cache & batch savings we need two derived metrics: 
- prefix_cache_token_savings = estimated_tokens_not_generated_due_to_prefix_cache = sum(estimated_prefix_tokens_skipped) 
- batching_token_savings = (naive_tokens_without_batching - actual_tokens_sent_to_model) estimated at aggregator based on batch_size distribution.
putting these at 1-min rollup level is feasible.

sana: product asks for a per-1k-token hover tooltip showing decomposition: gpu_cost, infra_fixed, cache_savings, batching_savings, routing_delta. please include both absolute and relative (%) numbers.

ajay: action items: 1) runtime (tom) -> finalize v2 rollup metric names & tags by EOD Thu. 2) infra (maria) -> publish cost table & mapping for gpu_cost_per_min by region by Fri. 3) devex (elena) -> mock console wireframe + compare-mode flows by next Wed. 4) product (sana) -> final formula and user-facing wording. we'll schedule 30m sync Thu 11am to lock schema + rollout plan.

elena-devex: will also add a small note about sampling assumptions on the dashboard and a "show raw sample" link to the logs for debugging.

maria: assign owner for ingestion QA — i'll volunteer infra to run a dry-run once runtime emits sample rollups. please tag @infra-bot when ready.

ajay: thanks all — tagging the owners: @tom @maria @elena-devex @sana. if anyone sees blockers for the Thu sync drop a note here. :thumbsup:
